# Oak National Academy

> Free, comprehensive National Curriculum-aligned teaching resources and AI-powered lesson planning tools for schools across all key stages.

Oak National Academy provides free, time-saving teacher resources including fully-sequenced curriculum plans, online lessons for pupils, and Aila—an AI-powered lesson assistant. The platform serves early years through GCSE, with a focus on reducing teacher workload while maintaining curriculum quality and safety standards.

## Key Topics

- National Curriculum
- Aila (AI lesson assistant)
- Lesson planning
- Teacher resources

## Core Platform & AI Tools

- [Oak National Academy Homepage](https://www.thenational.academy): Main entry point offering free teacher resources, curriculum plans, and AI-powered lesson tools.
- [Aila: AI-Powered Lesson Assistant](https://www.thenational.academy/ai): Free AI-powered lesson assistant for creating customized lesson plans and resources with DfE safety compliance.
- [Oak AI Experiments Lab](https://labs.thenational.academy): Experimental AI tools and Aila lesson builder for teachers, free and in beta.
- [Who We Are](https://www.thenational.academy/about-us/who-we-are): About Oak National Academy: mission, organization, and free educational platform overview.

## Curriculum & Lesson Planning

- [Free Curriculum Plans (National Curriculum Aligned)](https://www.thenational.academy/curriculum): Comprehensive free curriculum plans aligned with National Curriculum across all key stages.
- [Teacher Curriculum Planning Resources](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/curriculum): National Curriculum-aligned curriculum plans for KS1-KS4, fully-sequenced and free.
- [RSHE/PSHE Curriculum](https://www.thenational.academy/blog/a-complete-trusted-rshe-pshe-curriculum-designed-to-help-schools-meet-statutory-expectations): Free RSHE/PSHE curriculum meeting statutory expectations for relationships, health, and social education.
- [SATs Preparation Resources](https://www.thenational.academy/blog/supporting-you-and-your-year-6-pupils-as-sats-approach): Targeted SATs preparation resources for year 6 English and maths.

## Teaching Resources by Key Stage

- [Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS) Resources](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/key-stages/early-years-foundation-stage/subjects): Free EYFS teaching resources and lesson planning materials for early years education.
- [Key Stage 1 (KS1) Resources](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/key-stages/ks1/subjects): Free KS1 teaching resources aligned with National Curriculum for infant schools.
- [Key Stage 2 (KS2) Resources](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/key-stages/ks2/subjects): Free KS2 teaching resources for ages 7-11, aligned with National Curriculum.
- [Key Stage 3 (KS3) Resources](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/key-stages/ks3/subjects): Free KS3 teaching resources with sequenced lessons for secondary schools.
- [Key Stage 4 (KS4) & GCSE Resources](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/key-stages/ks4/subjects): Free KS4 teaching resources for GCSE exam preparation and secondary subjects.

## Student Learning & Content

- [Free Online Lessons, Videos & Quizzes for Pupils](https://www.thenational.academy/pupils): Free online lessons, videos and quizzes for pupils from KS1 to KS4 and GCSE.

## Professional Development & Support

- [Free Webinars for Teachers](https://www.thenational.academy/webinars): Free webinars for teacher professional development on Aila and lesson planning.
- [AI Safety & Compliance Guidance](https://www.thenational.academy/blog/choosing-ai-for-your-school-how-our-ai-tools-exceed-the-dfe-latest-safety-standards): Guidance on Aila AI tool safety standards, GDPR compliance, and DfE guidelines for schools.
